comparison.objective: Re-sort six bottles between crowded vertical rack levels without disturbing neighbors; candidate sifts mixed loose bodies.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated horizontal extraction/insertion in constrained shelf clearances and preservation of adjacent upright bottles versus dynamic bulk separation through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Required bottle-color distribution, upright containment, neighbor preservation and released stability versus media recovery ratio, washer retention, spill avoidance and supported screen dwell.
comparison.reason: Both involve multiple-object sorting, but bottle-by-bottle rack reclassification tests constrained placement, while the candidate tests simultaneous geometry-based separation of a mixture.
